description: Search one website's knowledge base and return the passages the chatbot would retrieve for this question, with a relevance score. Use this to check what the chatbot knows about a topic. It does not generate an answer and does not use the message allowance.

limit.description: How many passages to return (1-20, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, in plain language.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: search_knowledge_base
title: Search the knowledge base
